d: The Grizzlies defeated the Cavaliers, 124-121 tonight in Cleveland. Cam Spencer contributed a team-high 26 points to go with 7 assists and 5 three pointers, with Taylor Hendricks of the Grizzlies adding an additional 20 points (6-7 FG, 1-2 3P) in the game. Donovan Mitchell finished with a team-high 34 points along with 4 rebounds for the Cavaliers in the losing effort. The Grizzlies improve their record to 11-4 with the win, while the Cavaliers fall to 8-8 for the season.
